newsitem.title: USA: Ford's Budget Rent a Car's president resigns.
newsitem.headline: Ford's Budget Rent a Car's president resigns.

text.p: Budget Rent a Car said Thursday its President William Plamondon has resigned ahead of the rental car agency's sale by Ford Motor Co. to Team Rental Group Inc.
Ford announced in mid-January that it was selling the Lisle, Ill.-based unit for $350 million in cash, as part of the carmaker's plan to exit the rental car business.

"Plamondon's departure allows the changes at Budget to continue to accelerate as Sandy Miller, Team's chairman and CEO, brings a sharpened perspective to the improvements already made by the more streamlined management staff at Budget," Budget said.
Budget said it expected the sale to be completed in March.
